issues.legal_issue: A Collector conducting an inquiry into a proposed acquisition of land for a company must give interested landowners a reasonable opportunity to be heard and to present material responding to the company’s claims.
material_facts: The Government initiated acquisition proceedings for a company seeking land for an industrial estate.
The Collector’s inquiry addressed matters including the company’s efforts to obtain land by negotiation at a reasonable price and the suitability and extent of the land proposed for acquisition.
The landowners challenged the acquisition notifications because they had not been heard or allowed to submit material in the Collector’s inquiry.
The governing rule did not specify the inquiry’s method, and the Collector’s report was recommendatory.
issues.conclusion: The Collector was required, in the interests of fair play, to observe natural justice by giving interested landowners a reasonable opportunity to be heard and to adduce material refuting the company’s allegations; the appeals were dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Natural justice may be implied from the nature of a statutory duty even where it is not expressly provided, and the required procedure depends on the circumstances, statutory framework, and function being performed. Under Rule 4 of the Land Acquisition (Companies) Rules, 1963, the Collector’s inquiry includes matters of vital importance to interested landowners, including the company’s negotiation efforts and the approximate compensation assessed with regard to sections 23 and 24 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894. The inquiry therefore requires a fair opportunity to be heard despite silence about its procedure and the recommendatory nature of the report. The Court relied on Suresh Koshy George v. University of Kerala, A. K. Kraipak v. Union of India, and State of Gujarat v. Patel Chaturbhai Narsibhai; the latter also explained that a later hearing under section 5A cannot be assumed because section 17 may permit that inquiry to be dispensed with.

predicates.company_land_acquisition_proceeding: The government is considering acquiring land at a company’s request.
predicates.collector_assesses_company_land_selectio: The Collector examines the company’s choice of land or its efforts to obtain land by negotiation.
predicates.landowners_have_interests_in_the_propose: The proposed acquisition concerns land in which the persons seeking to participate have an interest.

issues.definition: When a company-requested acquisition involves a Collector examining the company’s land selection or negotiation efforts and affects landowners’ interests, those landowners must have a reasonable opportunity to be heard and present material.
